claim: G32 R1: one frozen, identical multi-case fixture bundle can demonstrate that every named constitutive participant changes at least one appropriate downstream capacity when its actual source/consumer relation is severed, while decorative and meaning-preserving changes do not; non-recursive oracle and zero-pitch clock behavior remain bounded.
non_claims: No claim that every mathematical authority, all nine flourishing enactors, general cognition, arbitrary language, every unauthorized identity, production multi-user operation, universal exactly-once behavior, kernel-proof containment, provider cancellation, or the complete G33 end-to-end organism is proven. No new external effect, live Mattermost contact, model inference, Chroma mutation, candidate promotion, or ongoing service is included.
rationale: G31 closes the bounded live omitted-part contact, but G32 must show causal integration rather than neighboring green reports. The control documents require source/consumer/consequence traces, meaningful severances, semantic stability under irrelevant changes, restoration, and honest partiality. A five-case bundle allows each component to matter where appropriate without inventing one universal all-components veto.
reading: Retain both complete controls, ACCEPTANCE G32, W-013-W-017/W-120-W-136, POC_SPEC 16-17, SC01-SC08 closures, G08-G21 raw gate evidence, G22-G31 closures, and especially committed G31 P9 closure SHA-256 0b02fd42e8f43506f1fb9736b6e4db80761cc1d61f9ec7c61f8e058395edd9c1 plus the frozen expected-arm matrix. Earlier gate evidence supplies provenance and test material, not an automatic integrated pass.
representation: Use one versioned five-case fixture bundle, source hashes for each actual subsystem participant, fresh-process native observations for canonical/severed/restored/neutral/held-out arms, a structured participation trace naming consulted versus load-bearing relations, and a matrix of predeclared expected versus observed downstream differences. The integration evaluator must be generic relational composition; arm IDs are builder labels and cannot be runtime behavior selectors.
consumer: Current native MeTTa subsystem consumers own their domain meanings. A test-only native integration fixture composes their actual returned standings and traces. Prolog may provide existing file/hash/process mechanics only where already pinned. JavaScript owns fixture assembly, process launch, raw capture and independent comparison; it cannot emit a passing native standing or choose a semantic response. No LLM is a judge.
falsifiers: Any arm receives different immediate fixture content except its declared single perturbation; a named severance fails to change its claimed consumer; Chroma loss erases exact capsule authority; NACE and consequence severance are conflated; workshop loss erases unrelated cognition; denied identity reaches cognition; VoiceAudit can be bypassed; VAD absence becomes fabricated affect; restoration fails; decorative/reordering changes standing; non-recursive makes a second oracle call; zero-pitch invents purpose/effects or step-count completion; host code selects semantic answers; prior reports substitute for execution; raw output is missing; private IDs/credentials/content enter tracked evidence; or a claim exceeds its observed domain.
scope_review: Add only G32 R1 plan/expectations, test-only native fixtures, builder verification scripts, and G32 evidence/outcome/closure. Read existing committed sources and redacted evidence. Do not modify Miter core or candidate code in R1; if execution exposes an actual integration defect, stop R1 with evidence and freeze a separately bounded repair revision. No network, Keychain, model, Docker, Chroma mutation, Mattermost operation, persistent runtime state, promotion, or push before closure.
rollback: Before closure, remove only disposable G32 test/evidence products or preserve a failed attempt; committed runtime/core and prior evidence remain untouched. Because R1 has no external effect or persistent runtime mutation, rollback is deletion of test-only generated state. A failed arm remains evidence and cannot be rewritten as a pass.
